title: Top 10 Madeira Sweets and Pastries to Try
description: Top 10 Madeira sweets and pastries to try: honey cake, queijada, passion fruit pudding, malasadas and more, plus where to find them in Funchal and beyond.
heroAlt: A table of Madeira sweets and pastries including honey cake and queijadas beside a cup of coffee

images.prompt: Photograph of a wooden bakery table in Funchal, Madeira, with slices of dark honey cake, small cheese tarts and a cup of coffee, soft morning window light, shot from slightly above.
images.alt: Madeira honey cake, cheese tarts and coffee on a bakery table

images.prompt: Close-up photograph of golden queijada cheese tarts on a tray in a traditional Madeira pastelaria, warm natural light.
images.alt: Fresh queijada cheese tarts on a bakery tray

images.prompt: Photograph of a glass of passion fruit pudding topped with fresh passion fruit pulp on a restaurant terrace table overlooking the sea in Madeira, golden afternoon light.
images.alt: Passion fruit pudding on a terrace table by the sea
